say:2:1720717001:0.text: Please help me... I haven't eaten in three days... My stomach hurts...
say:2:1720717001:0.source_cn: 漂亮的姐姐，好心的哥哥，行行好吧……我已经三天没吃饭了...

say:3:1720717002:1.text: Oh my... three days without food! Where are your parents?
say:3:1720717002:1.source_cn: 天哪！三天没吃饭……怎么会这样？你的……家人呢？

say:4:1720717003:1.text: Mom passed away, and Dad took all the money to the Twilight Pavilion, leaving my sick sister and me behind...
say:4:1720717003:1.source_cn: 妈妈去世了，爸爸带着家里所有的钱去了霁月会馆，只留下了...

say:5:1720717004:1.text: ... I can bear the hunger, but I need money to get my sister treated...
say:5:1720717004:1.source_cn: ……我可以饿肚子，可是没有钱的话，妹妹的病要怎么办……

say:6:1720717005:1.text: Rowan, how much money do you have on you? Give it all to this girl! We have to help her!
say:6:1720717005:1.source_cn: 罗万！快！快拿钱出来！把你身上的钱都给她！我们得帮帮她！

say:8:1720717006:1.text: Prin... Lady Penny, hold on. We need to get a clearer picture first.
say:8:1720717006:1.source_cn: 佩……佩小姐，你冷静点。事情也许没这么简单，我们先了解...

say:9:1720717007:1.text: Rowan, what are you talking about?! Can't you see she's starving? How can you be so cold?
say:9:1720717007:1.source_cn: 罗万！你……你在说什么呀？她都饿成那样了！你怎么能这么冷漠？

say:10:1720717008:0.text: I know you're money-minded, but I didn't know you were heartless! If you don't give her any money, I... I won't talk to you ever again!
say:10:1720717008:0.source_cn: 你平时虽然爱钱，但我以为你是有爱心的！你要是不给，我就...

say:11:1720717009:0.source_cn: 唉……好好好，我给，我给就是了。

say:13:1720717010:0.text: Rowan fishes a few gold coins out of his pouch and tosses them into the girl's bowl. Beaming, the girl thanks him profusely and dashes off into a nearby alley.
say:13:1720717010:0.source_cn: 罗万从钱袋里摸出几枚金币，放进了小孩的碗里。小孩眼睛一...

say:14:1720717011:0.text: Great! She can use the money to buy food and get her sister treated...
say:14:1720717011:0.source_cn: 太好了，有了这些钱，她就能买很多好吃的了，也可以治好妹...

choice_prompt:15:1720717011.text: Great! She can use the money to buy food and get her sister treated...
choice_prompt:15:1720717011.source_cn: 太好了，有了这些钱，她就能买很多好吃的了，也可以治好妹妹的病……

say:17:1720717013:0.text: Peggy... the world isn't as simple as it seems in the fairy tales.
say:17:1720717013:0.source_cn: 佩吉……有些事情，不像你在童话书里看到的那么简单。

say:18:1720717014:1.text: Do you know why I was reluctant to give her the money just now? Come, let's follow her and find out.
say:18:1720717014:1.source_cn: 你想知道我刚才为什么犹豫吗？来，我们悄悄跟上去看看。

say:19:1720717015:0.text: Follow her? ... Yeah, why not? We can visit her sister and bring her some medicine.
